doc:
A mark that could not be written must not leave `undo` acting on an older turn's mark. Three arms,
        each a fresh kernel: (a) no mark has ever existed and `runtime/` is read-only; (b) a stale mark from
        turn one with the mark file unwritable and its folder writable; (c) the same with the folder read-only,
        where the fix's own `remove_file` cannot land. qal-j10's shape, #444's fix.

breaks.detail: arm (b, mark folder writable): the mark could not be rewritten at turn two's start, and `undo` reset to 01e550f243a9 — turn one's commit 3b2a54dd556d is unreachable and a.txt is gone. The mark said 01e550f243a9; `undo` reported ['restored 01e550f243a98579d3c3dd7571069faf89aa56ab']
breaks.where: arbos-engine tools/git.rs snapshot_turn_tree — a mark that cannot be written is removed, and `undo` with no mark refuses (#444)

breaks.detail: arm (b): `undo` neither restored to turn two's start nor said why it refused — HEAD 01e550f243a9, said ['restored 01e550f243a98579d3c3dd7571069faf89aa56ab']

arm (c, mark folder read-only): the mark could not be rewritten at turn two's start, and `undo` reset to 01e550f243a9 — turn one's commit 4a8bf9935563 is unreachable and a.txt is gone. The mark said 01e550f243a9; `undo` reported ['restored 01e550f243a98579d3c3dd7571069faf89aa56ab']
breaks.where: arbos-engine tools/git.rs snapshot_turn_tree — a mark that cannot be written is removed, and `undo` with no mark refuses (#444)

breaks.detail: arm (c): `undo` neither restored to turn two's start nor said why it refused — HEAD 01e550f243a9, said ['restored 01e550f243a98579d3c3dd7571069faf89aa56ab']
